observations.text: Reassessment scope, mechanically selected: git diff 0068420 HEAD -- crates/foundry-acceptance docs/feature/iis-secrets-key-replace/acceptance.md (exit 0) returns 4 files, 327 insertions, 3 deletions - steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs +10 (one Given/When regex), support/instance_integration_setup.rs +70 (constants and given_other_server_quiet_between_words), tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature +51 (one S2 scenario at 1256-1272 and one S3 scenario at 1527-1548), acceptance.md +199 (S2 rows 8-10 and three S3 rows). git diff --stat f36b357 HEAD -- crates/foundry-acceptance (exit 0) shows the same acceptance delta, so the whole acceptance delta of this round is fd385f0. Only the S2 scenario, the shared step and support, and the S2 rows are judged here; the S3 scenario at 1527 and the S3 rows belong to the S3 reviewer and were not reassessed.

Semantic RED of the delta, from the supplied run only, no lane executed here: argv timeout -k 30 590 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c 'source scripts/eip-lanes.sh; eip_warm; eip_lane us-iis-07', exit 101, 32 scenarios with 30 passed and 2 failed, 561 steps with 559 passed and 2 failed, 0 parsing errors and 0 hook errors. The S2 failure is the new scenario's step at instance-integration-setup.feature:1268:5, which at HEAD is the read of 'Another Foundry server still opens the secrets key, so Start over is not offered.'; the preceding restore-words step at 1267 passed and the captured 200 OK page carries the shipped I-26 restore words and offers Start over. So the checkpoint that fails is the promised business observation of P6 and not an import, fixture, collection or startup defect, and the 29 other scenarios of the lane stayed green.

The falsifier of run D is reachable on the pre-correction code, verified read-only: crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/instance.rs:583 builds the gate as LiveOpeners::at(state.clock.now(), integrations.settings().reload) and secrets_key_rotation.rs:624 the same, so today's window is sized from the reading server's own FOUNDRY_INTEGRATIONS_RELOAD_MS, which the acceptance harness sets to 200 ms (support/instance_integration_setup.rs:115,537). That is exactly the wrong behaviour named in the falsifier and in architecture.md:106 and :1886 (m9), and it is what the captured page shows by offering Start over. The scenario therefore fails if and only if the window is not the constant the corrected D5 fixes.

The stimulus the new step constructs is deterministic and matches the run D the design declares (architecture.md:3052). support/instance_integration_setup.rs:3408-3445: the step asserts the running-server precondition, brings the second server's own clock up to this Foundry's reading of the time, awaits one recorded opener beat at that instant, then advances this Foundry's clock alone to that beat plus QUIET_BETWEEN_WORDS. The second server keeps its own frozen fake clock, so its reload rewrites the row at the same beat_at and the quiet stays exactly 20 s however long the poll takes; the relative advance also holds when that server's clock was ahead. A 10 s beat interval plus the 200 ms harness reload gives a longest real gap of 10.2 s, so 20 s is genuinely longer than the gap between two of its words and inside the 40 s window - the interior point the title names, with no wall-clock race and no shared-state dependency.

Closure of the delta in both directions. Forward: the page-reachable half of L12 that architecture.md:68 assigns to the acceptance oracle is now whole - a fresh beat reads live and Start over stays withheld (scenario at 1290 of the prior round), a beat older than the window reads gone and Start over is offered with its cost (the stopped-server scenario, where the minute that passes makes the row 60 s old against a 40 s window), and the interior quiet between two words reads live (the new scenario). Backward: every observation of the new scenario maps to one authority - the restore words and the live-server sentence and the withheld Replace to P6 and E12, the start-over GET answering the integrations page to P7 and E15, and the preservation to E18. It adds no observation without authority and no expectation row changed, so run D strengthens E12 rather than widening scope.

The new scenario keeps the mandates the prior round accepted for its sibling. It drives only the production router through the shipped page and start-over doors; its Given steps are the sibling's Given plus the new quiet, so the chained narrative holds and no setup is copied; its title and steps carry no production symbol, layer term or process id and name the user outcome; the two reads are the journey the declared S2 stimulus states, the same shape as the sibling accepted at 0068420. Its assertions are page reads and a preserved-state read: then_nothing_replaced at support:2795-2821 compares the stored key through the test seam, the whole Activity list and the config version every replica follows, so the row's claim that all three are as they were is backed and an undeclared change fails the test. No private field, mock call or shape-only assertion appears. The replace GET and POST of run A are not repeated in run D, which loses no observation: P6 conditions that answer on the key mode alone and the dedicated replace-under-I-26 scenario owns it.

Recorded limitation, not a defect: support/instance_integration_setup.rs:2987-3005 restates the 10 s beat interval and the 20 s reload envelope as its own constants and derives LIVE_WINDOW 40 s, QUIET_BETWEEN_WORDS 20 s and BEAT_WAIT 15 s from them, with a compile-time assert that the quiet lies between one beat interval and the window. Both figures are authority facts of the accepted ADR-IIS-SKR-003 (architecture.md:38,106), not values read back from the code under test, so the oracle's expected values stay independent. BEAT_EVERY at reload.rs:25 and the window constants of LiveOpeners are crate-private to foundry-app and invisible to foundry-acceptance, and the design adds no seam for a second setting, so no import is constructible inside the oracle's permitted surface. The residual risk is bounded: were the authority cadence to grow, the 20 s quiet would become a weaker interior point of a longer window, never a false pass, and the exact boundary is observed by T3 where the window is decided.

S2 rows 9 and 10 bind T3 and T4 to the gate type's own test module at crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs, which exists and already carries a proptest module at line 400. architecture.md:68 declares both as architectural checks of S2 and S3 and as completion obligations of the gate's craft, because the acceptance harness gives every server one FOUNDRY_INTEGRATIONS_RELOAD_MS and the retention hour is on no page, so neither is page-reachable. They are constructible: both constants they read are in the same crate and only widen to pub(crate). Judged here as declared and bound, with no pre-craft RED of their own required and none claimed; they are preserved as completion obligations under the command scripts/test-in-lima.sh cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::secrets_key_rotation. The acceptance designer owns neither run.

Capability limits of this round. typesafe: unavailable - python /Users/jeffbailey/.claude/skills/nw-typesafe-system-one/scripts/jev_decide.py --request - --output - with three reviewer-owned questions (does the new observation separate the promised gate from the named wrong behaviour; how to classify the oracle-side restated constants; how to treat the two architectural rows before craft) exited 3 with 'TYPESAFE_API_KEY is absent from this process environment', run from a shell command; nothing was transmitted and all three were answered locally from the evidence above. No lane was executed in this round: the supplied run covers the only check this phase needs on these bytes, the feature file at HEAD still reads the failing step at 1268 that the log names, and git shows no acceptance change after fd385f0, so the run and the judged bytes are the same revision. No timing measurement was taken or claimed; no test of this oracle is at or above half its budget by any supplied receipt.

diagnostic: ACCEPTED. Reassessment of the D5 delta only (fd385f0 over 0068420): the new S2 scenario at instance-integration-setup.feature:1256-1272, its shared step and support, and S2 rows 8-10. No findings, blocking or advisory. The delta closes the page-reachable half of L12 that architecture.md:68 assigns to this oracle: the interior quiet between two words of a live opener now reads as a live opener, beside the fresh beat and the beat past the window already accepted. Its semantic RED is measured on these exact bytes - the promised live-server sentence fails at 1268 while the restore words before it pass and the captured page offers Start over, which is the pre-correction gate LiveOpeners::at(now, reload) sized from the reading server's 200 ms setting, the one wrong behaviour the falsifier names. The stimulus is deterministic: exactly 20 s of quiet against a 10.2 s beat gap and a 40 s window, built by advancing the reading clock alone while the judged server keeps its frozen clock. The observations stay business-visible through the production router, preserve the key, the whole Activity and the config version, and add no observation without authority. Two recorded limitations, neither a defect: the oracle restates the 10 s cadence and 20 s envelope because both production constants are crate-private and no seam exists, which can only weaken the interior point and never pass a defect; and T3 and T4 are judged as declared, constructible craft completion obligations with no pre-craft RED required. typesafe: unavailable (jev_decide.py exit 3, key absent); all judgments local. Unchanged prior judgments of this oracle are retained. Implementation GREEN of the 40 s window, and the T3 and T4 runs, remain completion obligations.
